title: Valiant Turtle robot
alt: A small robot turtle with a clear green shell over its circuit board and a white base with legs and a head, beside a sheet of paper covered in coloured spirals made of many turned squares.
author: Valiant Technology Ltd.
description: The infra red controlled Valiant Turtle Robot was launched in 1983 and stayed in production until 2011. Image by Valiant Technology Ltd.
